about.title: About Upendra Thakur
about.lead: Performing since the age of 10 and commanding stages professionally since his early twenties, Upendra Thakur has redefined the art of Indian magic on the global stage.
bioParagraphs: A distinguished History Honours graduate from Delhi University, Upendra Thakur brings an intellectual depth, theatrical sophistication, and razor-sharp psychological intuition to every performance. For more than three decades, he has captivated royalty, heads of state, corporate conglomerates, and audiences of millions with his spellbinding blend of classical sleight-of-hand, mind-bending mentalism, and grand stage illusions.

His distinctive style combines the regal charm of Indian heritage with the high-octane spectacle of modern world-class illusion. Whether making massive objects vanish in front of thousands or reading the thoughts of high-profile CEOs in intimate corporate galas, Upendra Thakur's artistry leaves spectators breathless.
With over 5,000 performances across 25+ countries, he continues to push the envelope of live entertainment—transforming the impossible into unforgettable memories.
